text:
maria: quick sync  launching a slim pricing page experiment next week. scope: tighten FAQ lines, test two tier-naming approaches, and ship a compact cost calculator. goal: fewer billing questions + higher trial starts.
josh: good. what's the priority FAQ list from support?
maria: top confusions are commitments vs pay-as-you-go and reserved/burst capacity. want single-sentence answers and a glossary tooltip.
lee: tier name ideas: Option A = "Core / Scale / Enterprise"; Option B = "Starter / Predictable / Mission". Option B feels clearer but we should A/B it.
sam: calculator UX proposal: big monthly slider + Committed / PAYG toggle. show "Estimated monthly" and a tiny line: "Includes batching discounts". advanced details collapsed.
nina: routing rule: if estimated_monthly >= 5000 USD -> enterprise SDR queue, else marketing nurture. capture utm_campaign + utm_source. also tag webinar signups for benchmark drip.
josh: benchmark narrative for webinar: we can say "Lower per-unit cost at production scale" and link to appendix. bench: ~35% lower cost on our Dedicated config for 4k token workloads vs Competitor Z. keep it non-technical.
maria: headline draft: "Pricing that matches production needs: clear tiers + instant estimates". bullets: clearer names, live calc, benchmark snapshot.
sam: FAQ microcopy draft: Q: "What does committing do?" A: "Committing reserves a monthly allocation at a lower unit price and gives priority capacity; extra use is billed PAYG." add tooltip for "priority capacity".
lee: CTA A/B: "Estimate my cost" vs "See my price". 50/50 split. track conversion to trial and inbound leads >= $5k.
nina: analytics: event = pricing_calc_result with props: commitment_mode, estimated_monthly_usd, utm_campaign, tier_variant. routing checks estimated_monthly_usd >= 5000.
josh: timeline: copy + mock by Tue, engineering wires slider Wed, QA Thu, webinar drip ready Fri. A/B test runs two weeks.
maria: localization: add EUR toggle and short EU privacy blurb. nina to file privacy review.
lee: marketing needs a one-slide benchmark snapshot for the webinar highlighting the 35% number and noting "Tested on Dedicated v2, 4k seq" in appendix.
sam: tiny UI detail: when Committed is selected show inline example: "Commit $X/mo -> Y reserved throughput". reduces follow-ups.
launch-bot: scheduled post created for 2024-09-12 10:00 UTC in #general with benchmark snapshot + pricing link.
maria: thanks all, next check-in tomorrow 11am PT to review mocks. :wave:
